name: Can you paint over existing wallpaper?

mainEntity.name: Can you paint over existing wallpaper?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it is technically possible to paint over wallpaper, we generally recommend removing it first for the best and most durable results. Painting over wallpaper can lead to issues such as bubbling, peeling, or visible seams over time, especially in humid environments. The labor and material cost of proper wallpaper removal and surface preparation initially might be offset by the longer lifespan and superior finish of the painted surface, avoiding costly rework later. This ensures a smoother, more professional finish that lasts.
acceptedAnswer.description: We generally recommend removing wallpaper before painting to avoid bubbling, peeling, and visible seams, ensuring a more durable and professional finish.
